author: Stuarts
body:
I'm sorry, but today i've been banned for combat logging and i find that confusing as i did not logg out!

I've already been through a time consuming verification of my computer via teamspeak by one of your staff members in order to not get banned because apparentley a few players reported me. And i do not want to get banned because of a one-time /leave whilst falling into the void.
I know that I have only been tempbanned but i find that being so for 3 days is a little too much.
I also suggest you add a CombatTimer to prevent commands in battle as I am most certainly not the only one to have done this in the match i was in.

Myworld6 did what was right although I have only done it once in a life-time, but I am making this post to ask you to resolve this issue
because it is very solvable through a plugin than having staff monitor everyone's commands and that 3 days is a little much :(.
If this were a known and common rule i wouldn't have tried it.

Thanks for taking your time in reading my post and I hope to be back on the server sooner :c

   -Stuart

replies.body:
Hey,

the moderator who banned you made a mistake. Your ban will be shortened, or you will just be appealed in 1 day time. Depending on the availability of a senior staff member. Sorry for any confusion.

Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
